name: Bhagalpur

queries.query: Bhagalpur Bihar official cadastral map parcel map bhu naksha
queries.result: First-party results identified Bihar's official BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, the Bhagalpur district administration land-record route, and the Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms department portal. The viewer's public shell exposed its current JavaScript/configuration and Bhagalpur district selection, but bounded anonymous API calls returned no usable hierarchy or parcel feature response.

queries.result: First-party Hindi/official results confirmed the Bihar भू-नक्शा route and the Bhagalpur district land-record link. The public viewer presents district, sub-division, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance and sheet controls; no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Government of Bihar BhuNaksha public cadastral mapping viewer. The current HTML exposes district BHAGALPUR as a selectable location and controls for sub-division, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance and sheet number. Its page links assets/misc/config.js and index.js, which were fetched and inspected.

Official Bhagalpur district administration land-record page directs users to the Bihar land-record service and labels the location Bhagalpur. This is local district custodian evidence, not parcel geometry evidence.
Official Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms portal lists Bhu-Naksha, online land records and related services.
Official Directorate of Land Records and Survey service page lists Online Map, Online Revenue Records and special-survey map services.

requests.outcome: Viewer shell loaded. It showed state Bihar and district option 22 BHAGALPUR; no parcel row was requested from the UI.
Current configuration was inspected; public service path is same-origin and the viewer uses REST endpoints, WMS, ScalarDatahandler and OpenLayers.

Current JavaScript was inspected. It identifies rest/Levels/count, rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel, rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref and WMS routes, but does not itself provide parcel data.
Response body was 0; no usable level hierarchy was returned for the bounded anonymous request.
Response body was empty; no district/subdivision/circle/mauza schema or parcel feature was obtained.
Response body was empty in the bounded request environment; no layer schema or CRS was retained.
